source.title: Changes in the WCA Board of Directors (June 2024)
source.content:
With the term of Board Member Blake Thompson coming to an end, an anonymous election took place on **June 1st, 2024**. The election was conducted according to the [WCA Motion: Election of Directors](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/05.2021.1%20-%20Election%20of%20Directors.pdf).

The Board received the applications of:

* Abdullah Gulab
* Blake Thompson
* Nick Silvestri

We are happy to announce that the election was successful and that Blake was re-elected and Nick was newly elected member of the WCA Board of Directors.

These changes have become effective immediately.

The applications can be viewed [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xinaEjBV4Eh8lQfejeQteynXBae87T-1?usp=sharing).

translation.title: WCA 董事会成员变动（2024 年 6 月）
translation.content:
随着董事 Blake Thompson 的任期即将结束，WCA 于 **2024 年 6 月 1 日**举行了无记名投票。选举依据[《WCA 议案：董事选举》](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/05.2021.1%20-%20Election%20of%20Directors.pdf)进行。

董事会收到以下申请人的材料：

* Abdullah Gulab
* Blake Thompson
* Nick Silvestri

我们很高兴地宣布，选举顺利完成：Blake 连任，Nick 新当选 WCA 董事会成员。

上述变动即刻生效。

申请材料可在[这里](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xinaEjBV4Eh8lQfejeQteynXBae87T-1?usp=sharing)查看。
